result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the top-right notification button appears visually broken because the bell icon is missing/invisible, leaving only a grey circle with a red notification dot.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is partially visible and its title 'Trattoria Piccol' is clipped by the right edge, making the card look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel spacing or card width so the partially visible card is either fully shown or clearly peeking without clipped text.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section shows a second restaurant card cut off at the bottom of the viewport, with its name and details hidden below the fold.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the section has enough padding or the list scrolls cleanly so partially visible cards are intentional.
